title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: You’ve already got it probably. Great guy, great makeup. Primo competitor. Was on a pitching staff full of really good arms and was basically Sully’s pick for #1 starter 3 straight years. Never a huge FB but locates it very well. Avg SL. Plus change up is an outpitch. Really good control/command. Big thing for me is he is a starter. Not a “wildcard” bullpen arm. If he’s healthy, he should start.
